aboutMe.title:
About
Krasimir Radev
aboutMe.aboutMeText:
I started laying tile in 2003, just out of trade school, on small bathroom jobs in the western suburbs. By 2008 I was handling marble installations in Point Piper. Today I run a tight crew of four, and we take on work that other tilers walk away from.

The work is physical, precise, and unforgiving. You can't hide a bad tile job — the grout lines speak for themselves. That's why every job I touch gets the same treatment: laser levels, proper substrates, correct adhesive selection for every material, and a finish that looks as good in ten years as it doeson day one.

I don't do volume work. I choose projects where quality matters and clients who understand that doing it right once is cheaper than doing it twice.
